A1. Website live with branding assets
B1. Agenda available on website, and proper communication in social media with at least tex X posts from the official X account of the event and/or from different relevant accounts such as TxPipe's, Mauro Andreoli's, Lucas MAcchiaveli's and Santiago Carmuega's. Also at least 5 posts in different relevant discord servers, such as Txpipe's and Pragma's

ms.report:
A2 — Event Website and Branding Assets The event website is live at https://buidlerfest.com, featuring the full branding assets for Cardano Buidler Fest #3 – Buenos Aires 2026. The event agenda is published and accessible at https://buidlerfest.com/agenda.
B2 — Communication Campaign Report. Access a detailed report of the communication campaign. In summary: 10 posts were published on X across 5 relevant accounts — @buidler_fest, @txpipe_tools, @FedeWeill, @santicarmuega, and @MauroAndreoliA — reaching a combined total of 30,370 impressions. Community announcements were also posted in 5 major Cardano Discord servers: TxPipe, PRAGMA, Cardano Foundation, IOG, and CDEC.
C2- Access the report here. The Call for Speakers ran from December 31, 2025 to February 1, 2026, promoted via buidlerfest.com, X, and Discord. 27 proposals were received from 24 unique speakers. 16 talks were selected, covering 6 technical topic categories and featuring 18 speakers.

ms.promise:
A. Deliver a full two-day event aligned with the published program, including a minimum of 8 sessions per day across talks, workshops, and collaborative activities. Include side activities such as community gatherings or co-creation spaces.
B. Ensure participation from at least:
・100 attendees (registered and physically present),
・8 speakers/workshop leaders,
・2 ecosystem partners or community organizations.

C. Capture media coverage including:
・At least 10 short-form clips (≤1 min),
・A photo archive of at least 50 images covering sessions, participants, venue, and interactions.
ms.criteria:
A. A session report is produced listing the agenda as executed (titles, speakers, duration), with confirmation that at least 8 sessions occurred across the two days.
B. Attendance is validated through:
・Pre-registration/export from registration platform 

C. Delivery of complete media package:
・At least 10 short highlight clips (Txpipe's YouTube Channel )
・Photo set uploaded and organized with public access.
